integrity: The claim is a deductive synthesis of published finite one-generator classification, Fraïssé ultrahomogeneity, and strong amalgamation. No computational experiment is used as a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Unary-orbit classification only; higher tuple orbits are not classified. Direct retrieval of the 2018 PDF failed during this check, so its generator statement was verified from indexed page text and bibliographic records and cross-checked against the later Nishimura article.
title: Exact unary orbit decomposition of the universal homogeneous Heyting algebra
